## E. Recorded review notes {.unnumbered}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
source("tools/evidence_notes.R", local = TRUE)
source("tools/report_typography.R", local = TRUE)
packages <- tar_read(report_stage_packages, store = store)
notes <- unlist(lapply(packages, function(package) package$notes), recursive = FALSE)
cat(protect_dollars(note_text(notes)), sep = "\n\n")
```
